title: Authentic Cacio e Pepe
subtitle: spaghetti with pecorino and black pepper
description: Classic Roman pasta with just three ingredients: spaghetti, freshly cracked black pepper and a creamy pecorino sauce made with the pasta water.

steps.text: Cook the pasta in boiling salted water according to the packet instructions.
Heat a large, heavy-based pan, lightly toast the coarsely ground pepper to release its flavour and turn off the heat.
Pour a ladle of the pasta cooking water into the pan, add half the grated pecorino and whisk well until smooth and creamy.
When the pasta is ready, drain it and transfer it straight to the pan.
Turn on the heat and cook together for another 2 minutes, mixing well and adding the remaining cheese.
Divide among individual plates and serve immediately.
